name: fhe-application-design
description: Design and build Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) applications with OpenFHE (optional Niobium DSL path). A twelve-stage methodology (0-11) from build environment and privacy model through the faithful twin, encrypted implementation, protocol specification, a simulation-validated Niobium Fog deployment, optimization of the running application, and a measured method for polynomial approximation of non-linear functions — including empirically-grounded CKKS bootstrapping guidance and the fhe-boot-lab probe.
